title: POS Weighing Scale & VFD Display
summary: The weight goes straight into the bill with no manual typing, and the customer-facing display shows what is being weighed and what it costs as it happens.

title: Tools Rental Management
summary: Every tool that goes out and comes back, with rental periods, customer details, timesheets and automatic cost calculation.

title: Mobile & IT Repair
summary: Job intake through to delivery: device and fault details, spare parts, technician assignment, repair status and invoicing.

title: POS Dynamic Invoice
summary: Branded, editable POS invoices — logo, company details, tax lines and footer — configured from the back office rather than in code.

title: POS Loyalty Card
summary: Points earned and redeemed at the counter, with the customer's balance and available rewards in front of the cashier during checkout.

title: KRA/KPI Management
summary: Set role objectives and score them on a purpose-built board, with results rolling up from the individual to the department.

title: User Privilege Manager
summary: Control what each user sees and does, field by field — hide menus, lock fields, and grant create, read, write and delete per person rather than per group.

title: Attendance Suite
summary: Late tracking with automatic deductions, leave and work-from-home requests, device management and reports, in one place.

title: Showroom Check
summary: Scheduled photo checks that a showroom still matches its agreed layout, with the evidence stored against every visit.

title: Signage Scan
summary: Full-screen promotional signage on in-store displays, doubling as a barcode price checker customers can use themselves.

title: PharmaCare Pharmacy POS
summary: A pharmacy counter with batch and expiry tracking, so short-dated stock is caught before it reaches a customer.

title: Credit Management
summary: Customer credit limits with an approval step, so an order beyond the limit stops and waits for a decision instead of shipping.

title: Inter-Company Stock Transfer
summary: Move stock and its value between companies with a request and approval flow, keeping both sets of books straight.

title: Offline Sync
summary: Keep billing when the connection drops — the counter switches to local data and syncs back afterwards, with a cross-check so nothing is duplicated or lost.

title: Vehicle Tracking
summary: Trips, driver logs and vehicle movement in one place, with automatic checks that flag journeys which do not add up.
